important_timing_disclosure: The seed-42 test result was inspected before training the additional robustness seeds. No model architecture, threshold, collapse parameter, evaluation definition, or seed was selected using the additional test results.

evaluation.primary_report: mean and standard deviation across five training seeds, with seed-42 document-bootstrap intervals retained as the prespecified primary-run uncertainty analysis

claim_rules.postprocessing_claim: Supported only if the non-overlap advantage remains positive across all or nearly all seeds.
claim_rules.collapse_claim: Supported only if collapse improves its matched baseline consistently across seeds. Otherwise report a null or negative result.
